title: Energy Project Talks & Tax Photo Deal
summary:
*   **Council convened a special closed-door meeting:** The council held a private executive session to discuss sensitive legal and real estate matters before any potential public decisions.
*   **South Texas Project discussions:** Key topics addressed in the private meeting included contemplated litigation and ongoing real estate negotiations concerning the significant South Texas Project.
*   **Tax department aerial photo contract:** In open session, a resolution was passed to amend an existing contract, directing the aerial photography services for the Tax Department through the Capital Area Planning Council (CAPCA).
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Called Council Meeting
November 25, 1981
12:00 NOON
First Floor Conference Room
124 West Eighth Street
Municipal Building
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call: Present: Mayor
McClellan, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Councilmembers Absent:
Deuser, Duncan, Goodman, Mullen
Councilmember Urdy
Mayor McClellan stated that this is a Special Called Meeting of the Council, and announced
that Council will convene in a closed or executive session authorized by Section 2,
Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated for
the purpose of discussing contemplated litigation and real estate negotiation matters to
the South Texas Project; and 2. Appointment of Board and Commission members. After such
closed or executive session any final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter
considered in the closed or executive session will be made in open session, should such
action, decision or vote be necessary.
Mayor McClellan announced that the Council would go into executive session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated.
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
November 25, 1981
The Council then convened in Executive Session. The Council then returned to open session.
AERIAL PHOTOGRAPHY FOR TAX DEPARTMENT
Council had before them a resolution to consider amending the resolution of November 4,
1981 to Hildebrand Surveys for vertical aerial photography, for the Tex Department to
provide that the contract for such services to be provided by Hildebrand. Aerial Surveys
will be with CAPCA
(Capital Area Planning Council).
Motion
-
FAILED TO PASS
Councilmember Mullen moved that the Council adopt a resolution.
The motion, seconded by Mayor McClellan, FAILED TO CARRY by the following vote: Ayes:
Mayor McClellan, Councilmember Mullen Noes: None Abstain: Mayor Pro Tem Trevino,
Councilmembers Deuser, Duncan Absent: Councilmember Urdy Not in Council Chambers when roll
was called: Councilmember Goodman The reason for the abstention of the three
Councilmembers was that Mayor Pro Tem Trevino had a question during roll call. When roll
call was finished Mayor Pro Tem Trevino's question was answered. Motion Mayor Pro Tem
Trevino moved that the Council adopt a resolution to amend the resolution of November 4,
1981 to Hildebrand Surveys for vertical aerial photography for the Tax Department to
provide that the contract for such services to be provided by Hildebrand Aerial Surveys
will be with CAPCA (Capital Area Planning Council). The motion, seconded by Councilmember
Deuser, carried by the following vote:
Ayes: Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Councilmembers Deuser, Duncan, Mullen, Mayor McClellan
Absent: Councilmember Urdy
Not in Council Chamber when roll was called: Councilmember Goodman
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting.
APPROVED Cla
Mayor
ATTEST:
Grace Monine
City Clerk
